task.description: Hard gate: review DDL-01/MIG-04/MIG-05/MIG-06 against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md. This is a tenant-data-path change: three NEW admin HTTP routes (src/api/routes/platform_migrations.zig -- run/status/resume, cross-tenant blast radius) gated by Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN, and a new boot-time DB-touching gate (src/operations/pending_migration_gate.zig). Check: role-gate correctness on all 3 routes (403 for non-PLATFORM_ADMIN, verified not just present but actually checked BEFORE any DB write), SQL parameterization, no catch unreachable, and specifically whether the MIG-06 status endpoint could leak cross-tenant information to a caller who should not see other tenants' migration failure details (even though PLATFORM_ADMIN legitimately sees all tenants, confirm this is the intended design, not an accidental broadening).
acceptance_criteria: Every numbered security invariant checked against the diff
All 3 new routes verified to check Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN before any DB write or read
No catch unreachable on realistic DB failure paths
Cross-tenant data exposure via the status endpoint explicitly assessed

result.summary: Security review for DDL-01/MIG-04/MIG-05/MIG-06 (commit ff7fc6a6): INV-1 (tenant isolation) applies and satisfied - lint_migration_schema.py and lint_sql_table_refs.py both exit 0; no migration files added; platform.platform_migrations is a platform-schema control table, not tenant business data. INV-2 (field authorisation) applies and satisfied - handleMigrationStatus per-tenant fields (tenant_id/status/error_msg/completed_at) are intentional per MIG-06 AC3 requirement text for a PLATFORM_ADMIN-only aggregate endpoint, not an accidental broadening. INV-3 not applicable (no Lua/Wasm host-API files touched). INV-4 not applicable (no secret material in any new/changed file, verified by grep). INV-5 not applicable (status endpoint is a platform-operator aggregate view, not a per-tenant lookup-by-ID resource probeable cross-tenant; no forbidden/not-found asymmetry exists on this route). INV-7 (SQL parameterisation) applies and satisfied - every SQL call site in platform_migrations.zig, pending_migration_gate.zig, and migration_fanout.zig uses $N placeholders exclusively; migration_id/tenant_id are never concatenated into SQL text; lint_sql_param_types.py exits 0; targeted grep for allocPrint-built SQL found zero hits. INV-8 (no catch unreachable) applies and satisfied - zero occurrences of catch unreachable anywhere in git diff main...HEAD. Additionally verified by hand: all three route handlers (handleRunMigration, handleMigrationStatus, handleResumeMigration) check actor.role != .PLATFORM_ADMIN as the literal first statement, before body parsing, pool.acquire(), or any query - an unauthorized caller triggers zero DB reads or writes. The seedPendingRow ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE ... WHERE status != 'done' guard is a standard Postgres conflict-predicate pattern: when the predicate is false (row is done), Postgres leaves the row completely unmodified, so a done row cannot be silently overwritten or downgraded. zig build and zig build test-ddl-validate both pass clean.
